dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Central has established a monthly material-output benchmark.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: For material we can't reliably predict?

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The target uses the pilot's most productive week.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: That was the week a damper failed. I don't intend to break another one for the chart.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: They projected a monthly target from one good batch. That's not a forecast.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The calculation is consistent. The assumption is weak.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Does the number come with the replacement parts we were promised?

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: It comes with priority consideration. Which is how we ended up discussing it at all.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: The bracket is still temporary. I can keep checking it, but I can't make the replacement appear.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: They've tied accelerated procurement to the new target.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: That's a dirty trick. It's also a part I want.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: That's exactly why I haven't just said no.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Our pilot terms say real work comes first. The target doesn't change that.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: It changes which work central will praise.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: And if they pay us for more material, they'll start treating every reading as a success or failure.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Does that mean we lose the quiet room if people aren't miserable enough?

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: No. Nothing of the sort.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: That's what I'm worried you'll have to keep saying.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The maintenance schedule and output target can be compared on the same calendar.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Move a small, legitimate check forward. We might get the part review sooner.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: We shouldn't schedule repairs because they might produce residue.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We aren't inventing repairs. We're changing when we do one.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The first adjustment has no apparent conflict.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: That isn't the same as no conflict.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Zib, could the vibration check be done tomorrow instead?

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Physically, yes. But tomorrow already belongs to another set of people.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I can ask about shifting the room schedule.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: It's not the room. It's the dock handoff and the tools we're using.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I'll take responsibility for the change.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Don't rush because headquarters has put a star next to this job.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I didn't know there were stars. I was hoping for lunch.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: The first trace is a reading, not a reward.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Vibration check is complete. Parameters are normal.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: And the new sample?

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Interesting. But we haven't proved why it appeared.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: The early check went well. The part request moved to priority review.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I was relieved until I saw you looking at next week's calendar.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: One adjustment hasn't harmed anything.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: No. But I remember what you said when we first sent that material report.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Could we move the conveyor service forward as well?

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: It's a bigger job. We'd have to take the cargo lane apart.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: There's a delivery scheduled the following morning.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We can finish before it arrives. I'll confirm the window.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: The samples are different sizes even with similar work. That's not a controllable output.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I know the target is shaky. The replacement part isn't imaginary.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I want the part too. I just don't want us to pretend the sample isn't telling us something inconvenient.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Write it down. I'll read it after the conveyor check.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Our projected output is ahead of target.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: At least the earlier maintenance seems to have bought us room.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Funny. I'm looking at the same calendar, and we've lost the room we needed for Dock Two.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: The cargo slot is tomorrow. We have time.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: How long before the conveyor is back in service?

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Long enough that I don't like seeing the Dock Two shipment already on the approach list.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I confirmed the window.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: You confirmed the planned time. The coupling didn't sign your calendar.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Show me what's left to do.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: The outer dock is reporting an early arrival.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Conveyor is still isolated. Nobody's moving cargo through this lane.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I can help with the interlock readings.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I can give the pilot an updated estimate, not a guessed one.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Don't let the output target affect the repair steps.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: It already affected when we started. Let's not let it affect how we finish.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: They've asked if we're having an emergency.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: It's a scheduling error, not an emergency. I can hear them asking for a shorter word.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I brought the service forward. I thought the lane would be clear.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Well, the lane isn't. They're going to want to know when it will be.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Finish isolation safely, clear the lane, and take the shipment. Forget today's target.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: The target isn't the part that's broken. It's the reason we're in the way.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I can give Dock Two five minutes if you can actually give me five minutes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I'm updating the arrival crew now.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Conveyor's restored. Check the interlock once more.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Dock Two outer latch is waiting. We've got one chance to look organized.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: They don't need organized. They need a working dock.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Finally, something we all agree on.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Latch confirms. Let them in.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I'll explain the delay. To the crew, not just the computer.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The material-output metric still shows us ahead.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: And the delivery was delayed because I moved a service job to improve it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The two results exist in different reports.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: That's the problem. Put the actual work schedule back the way it belongs.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: The dock crew lost an hour because we wanted a better graph.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Because I wanted the replacement parts. That's why I made the call.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: Wanting the parts wasn't wrong. Making the rest of us absorb the change without asking was.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I know. The schedule is back. I'll speak to the dock crew.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: The honest material forecast misses central's target.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Even though the station's repairs and response times improved.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Put them beside each other. I want whoever reads this to see both.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: That won't make them like the numbers.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: No. But it will make them understand whose work the numbers interrupted.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I moved the conveyor service early. Dock Two paid for it. That's on me.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: The work wasn't unnecessary. The timing was.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: And I never want another schedule built around the hope somebody finds a lucky sample.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: There's a difference between doing a good job and making a good-looking report.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I can document both without pretending they're identical.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Then that's the report we have, not the one the target wanted.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: We're sending a missed target with an improved operations record. That's an odd combination.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: It's the true one.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Are you still hoping they send the bracket?

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Every morning. I'm capable of being stubborn and accurate at once.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Central is offering us a final choice: meet the output target or submit a different operating proposal.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: We already tried making the station fit the target.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: This time I'm writing what the station actually is.
